label: GPT-5.6 Luna
headline: Fresh Exchanges Rekindle Three Contested Fronts
war_summary: The latest returns shift attention from yesterday’s older clashes to three fronts now showing fresh movement. MarbanHollow logged three strategic-base events in the past two hours and remains divided among four Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral holding; both casualty rates are accelerating. NevishLine recorded two events in that window, with six Warden and two Colonial bases, while losses and enlistments are rising sharply. WeatheredExpanse also saw two recent events and remains fractured among six Warden, one Colonial, and two neutral positions, with heavy losses accelerating on both sides. The broader contested belt remains unsettled: PalantineBerm posted 30 events in 24 hours, LinnMercy 20, and Godcrofts 46, though none of those three recorded movement in the latest two hours. StlicanShelf, prominent in the previous edition, has no event in the latest two-hour window despite 14 daily events. CallahansPassage is absorbing the heaviest current casualty traffic without recorded base movement. Most other sectors remain quiet or firmly held, and the war has no declared victor.

headline: Fresh Clashes Shake Marban Hollow and Weathered Expanse Fronts

Meanwhile, Stonecradle and Palantine Berm sustained heavy pressure and mounting butcher's bills, whereas earlier hotspots in Linn of Mercy, Godcrofts, and Stlican Shelf experienced a relative lull in active base conversions.

label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
headline: Marban Hollow Heats Up as Nevish Line Eases and Godcrofts Lies Silent
war_summary:
Fighting has boiled over again at Marban Hollow, where three actions were logged in the past two hours — the latest just before midnight — with Oster Wall the scene of most of it. Wardens lost 236 men in that span against 107 Colonial, and both rates are still climbing. The Nevish Line, which erupted a day ago, has eased to a single action in two hours, though Blackcoat Way remains contested and hourly casualties near 450 apiece are rising rather than falling.

Godcrofts, hottest ground of the day with forty-six actions, has not fired since early afternoon; its nine works stay Colonial. Weathered Expanse returned to the lists late in the evening about Spirit Watch and Crow's Nest, more than a thousand casualties falling on each side in two hours, with two of its works still unclaimed. Linn Mercy holds nine works against one Warden and one unclaimed; Palantine Berm stands split four Warden to three Colonial after thirty actions. The victory mark remains thirty-four towns.

colonial_attack.reason: Warden-held base in NevishLineHex with recent flip history and high Colonial pressure indicated by casualty rates.

label: GLM 5.3 Flash
headline: Marban Hollow Stirs as Nevish Line Toll Soars
war_summary: Marban Hollow has broken its long quiet, posting the freshest flag action of any region — three events inside two hours, Oster Wall its busiest post — while the Nevish Line's hourly toll has leapt to roughly 450 on each side, the day's movement centered on Blackcoat Way, Grief Mother, and Tomb Father. Weathered Expanse has returned to the ledger as well, two actions since late evening, with Spirit Watch and Crow's Nest its busiest posts. Callahans Passage remains the costliest front of all, some 2,200 casualties in two hours, yet not a base there has moved all day. Stlican Shelf, last edition's lead, has gone quiet in flag terms even as its casualty counts accelerate, while Godcrofts, still the day's busiest ledger at forty-six actions, has logged nothing in six hours. Palantine Berm's fighting stays heavy though its last transfer came at mid-afternoon, Stonecradle's toll is surging sharply around The Reach without a flag moving since dawn, and Linn Mercy has cooled markedly, its flags resting since early evening. The prize stands at thirty-four victory towns; neither banner yet claims the war, now in its 631st day.

colonial_reinforce.reason: Necropolis was only just retaken from the Wardens and sits in the war's heaviest sustained battle (~600 casualties/hour per side); a Warden counterattack is the most likely next move, so Colonial players should rebuild its garrison and fortify before defenses are tested.

colonial_attack.reason: Vendett is a Warden Town Base I that has flipped five times in the past day, and its current Warden hold (~10 hours) is already longer than any hold it had earlier today; Warden attrition in the region (280/hr) far exceeds Colonial losses (200/hr), so renewed Colonial pressure on it is likely to succeed.

warden_reinforce.reason: Oster Wall was demolished and recaptured only minutes before the cutoff, its sixth ownership change today; Wardens are bleeding at roughly double the Colonial rate in Marban Hollow, so immediately rebuilding and garrisoning it is the top priority to stop the cycle of Colonial raids.

warden_attack.reason: Blackcoat Way flipped to the Colonials only about 75 minutes before cutoff in the most active region in the packet (~450 casualties/hour per side with rising enlistment); Wardens have retaken this base twice today, and a rapid counter before Colonial defenses harden is the highest-value strike available.
